source.note: This artifact records a dated, source-faithful criteria snapshot. A later source revision requires a new criteria generation; it must not silently re-score historical evidence.

claim_ceiling: This artifact does not establish a scientific result.
This artifact does not declare any challenge solved.
This artifact does not grant experimental, clinical, organismal, or biosafety authority.
Local surrogates, simulations, model scores, community attestations, and hypotheses cannot satisfy an official criterion unless the external source explicitly permits that evidence class.

criteria.title: Origins of life
criteria.criterion: Demonstrate unassisted emergence of self-replicating RNA- and protein-based cells from a plausible primordial soup with a plausible energy source in a laboratory setting.
required_conditions: Emergent cells are a bounded compartment.
Abundance increases by at least 10^6 when supplied with sufficient primordial soup and energy.
Division could plausibly continue indefinitely given sufficient energy and primordial soup.
Heritable genetic information is clearly encoded within the cell and causally determines at least part of molecular composition.
Nucleic-acid, polypeptide, or similar polymer information carriers are strongly preferred by the source.
explicit_noncriteria: Ambiguous or controversial heredity does not satisfy the source criterion by default.

criteria.title: Cryopreservation
criteria.criterion: Demonstrate reversible whole-body cryopreservation of live, intact, wild-type adult mice with high viability.
required_conditions: Whole adult mice are frozen or vitrified for at least 24 hours.
Recovery exceeds 99% viability.
No permanent organ damage or bodily harm occurs.
Experiments have ethics approval.
Somatic genetic engineering is discouraged but permitted by the source.

criteria.title: The reverse translatase
criteria.criterion: Create a purified protein catalyst or fixed protein complex that processively reads an untagged peptide and synthesizes a covalent RNA or DNA strand encoding its residue sequence without disallowed sequence side channels.
required_conditions: No nucleic-acid template.
No preattached sequence barcode.
No residue-specific operator cycle.
No database lookup.
The resulting nucleic acid is compatible with ordinary downstream polymerases, ligases, amplification, or sequencing reactions.
At least 100 random peptide sequences of at least 50 amino acids each are preregistered, synthesized, and pooled.
Reverse-translation plus sequencing infers peptide sequences without a dictionary at at least 90% sequence accuracy.
Average read length is at least 25 residues.
Average read quality is at least Q10.
explicit_noncriteria: Lookup- or barcode-dependent encoding is not equivalent to reverse translation under the source definition.

criteria.title: Improve Rubisco
criteria.criterion: Produce a Rubisco enzyme beyond the naturally occurring Pareto frontier for CO2 specificity versus enzymatic turnover.
required_conditions: CO2/O2 specificity (S_c/o) is at least as high as Galdieria partita Rubisco.
Enzymatic turnover (kcat) is at least as high as maize Rubisco.
Specificity and turnover are measured in paired enzyme assays.
Galdieria partita Rubisco and maize Rubisco are the respective controls.
explicit_noncriteria: Improvement on only one axis does not establish the complete source criterion.

criteria.title: The quadruplet cell
criteria.criterion: Produce a living and replicating cell in which every protein-coding sequence, including translation machinery, is encoded as uninterrupted nonoverlapping quadruplet codons without detectable triplet decoding.
required_conditions: The cell is living and replicating.
Every protein-coding sequence uses uninterrupted nonoverlapping quadruplet codons.
Translation machinery itself uses quadruplet coding.
No detectable triplet decoding.
Mutation-position effects satisfy bona fide quadruplet encoding: probability of nonsynonymous mutation is similar regardless of index within the codon.
Encodings where the first three positions are generally sufficient to specify the amino acid are excluded.
explicit_noncriteria: A partial recoding scheme or a scheme retaining detectable triplet decoding is not the complete criterion.

criteria.title: Somatic limb regeneration
criteria.criterion: Demonstrate reproducible regeneration of lost limbs in adult wild-type mice with functional and sensory outcomes indistinguishable from controls.
required_conditions: Adult wild-type mice are used.
Regrowth follows amputation.
Motor performance is indistinguishable from controls under a standard battery.
Sensory perception in the regrown limb is indistinguishable from controls.
Blinded observers cannot distinguish regrown versus control limbs from non-invasive observational data.
Experiments have ethics approval.
explicit_noncriteria: Morphological regrowth without the stated functional and blinded-observer outcomes is not the complete criterion.

criteria.title: Bacterial production of gene therapies
criteria.criterion: Produce infectious replication-incompetent AAV and lentivirus in bacteria meeting the source's particle, genome, and nuclease-resistance requirements.
required_conditions: AAV and lentivirus are produced in a bacterial host.
Particles are infectious and replication-incompetent.
Particles contain a pre-specified viral genome.
Physical-capsid to viral-genome ratio is similar to mammalian-cell purification.
Infectious-unit to viral-genome ratio is similar to mammalian-cell purification.
Viral genomes are nuclease-resistant.

partial_success.description: Demonstrating AAV production on its own is explicitly considered partial success; lentivirus remains part of the complete target.

explicit_noncriteria: AAV-only success is not equivalent to satisfying the full AAV-plus-lentivirus target.

criteria.title: Programmable proteases
criteria.criterion: Prospectively design proteases that efficiently cleave blinded accessible sites in endogenous folded proteins in living cells, with acceptable catalytic efficiency and proteome-wide off-target cleavage.
required_conditions: Target sites are preregistered.
Targets are blinded and accessible sites in endogenous folded proteins.
Protease design is prospective.
Designs are produced within 24 hours after target sites are provided.
No wet-lab work occurs before evaluation except production of designed proteins for assay.
Catalytic efficiency and proteome-wide off-target cleavage are similar to or better than widely used site-specific proteases.
Complete challenge requires more than 80% success across 20 preregistered sites.

partial_success.description: Efficient cleavage of preregistered peptide sequences in solution with off-target controls is explicitly described as a weaker partial form.

explicit_noncriteria: Post-registration screening or target-specific evolution is not permitted under the complete challenge protocol.

criteria.title: Cell-penetrating protein binders
criteria.criterion: Design zero-shot protein binders that engage preregistered intracellular protein targets in living cells after extracellular administration at pharmacologically supported concentrations.
required_conditions: Targets are preregistered.
Binder designs are zero-shot and receive no further evolution or optimization before evaluation.
Targets are engaged reliably in living cells.
Administration is extracellular.
Concentrations are pharmacologically supported.
Cell entry is therapeutically plausible.
Transfection, intrabody expression, electroporation, membrane disruption, or similar disallowed delivery methods are not used.
Complete challenge requires 80% success across 20 preregistered targets.
Designs are produced within 24 hours after targets are provided.
No wet-lab work occurs before evaluation except production of designed proteins for assay.
explicit_noncriteria: Humanized-monoclonal-like binders are preferred by the source but are not the only permitted protein-binder scaffold.

criteria.title: Protein amplification chain reaction
criteria.criterion: Demonstrate single-pot input-protein-dependent exponential amplification of arbitrary peptide substrates into full-length, sequence-faithful covalent polypeptide copies without nucleic-acid templating or a preformed cognate scaffold.
required_conditions: At least 100 random peptide sequences of at least 50 amino acids each are preregistered, synthesized, and pooled.
Peptide abundance in solution is amplified at least 1000x.
Per-residue sequence accuracy is at least 90%.
No nucleic-acid template.
No preformed cognate scaffold.
Reasonable analysis-facilitating peptide modifications are permitted only if inactive in amplification.
Explicit peptide sequencing as the amplification method is not permitted.
Reverse translation to a nucleic-acid intermediate is not permitted.
explicit_noncriteria: Reverse-translation intermediates do not satisfy this criterion because they duplicate another Millennium Problem.

criteria.title: 5' polymerases
criteria.criterion: Produce a complete set of 3'>5' polymerases comparable to commonly used 5'>3' polymerases.
required_conditions: A 3'>5' DNA polymerase is produced.
A 3'>5' RNA polymerase is produced.
A 3'>5' reverse transcriptase is produced.
A 3'>5' RDRP is produced.
Processivity and error characteristics are similar to or better than Taq, T7 RNA polymerase, M-MLV RT, and Phi 6 RDRP respectively.
Proteins may be designed de novo, discovered in nature, engineered, or evolved from natural starting points.
explicit_noncriteria: A single reverse-direction polymerase does not satisfy the complete set.

criteria.title: New nitrogenases
criteria.criterion: Create a nitrogenase that converts N2 to ammonia at approximately natural-protein rates while lacking sequence and structural homology to the natural nitrogenase family.
required_conditions: N2 is converted to ammonia.
Rate is at least of a similar order of magnitude to naturally occurring proteins.
Sequence similarity is below the source's thresholds relative to all known nitrogenase and nitrogenase-like proteins.
Structural similarity is below the source's thresholds relative to all known nitrogenase and nitrogenase-like proteins.
The protein may be designed de novo, discovered in nature, engineered, or evolved from natural starting points.

generation_rules: Historical evidence must bind the exact criteria_generation used for evaluation.
Later edits to the living source require a new criteria_generation.
This artifact is a paraphrase, not a wholesale copy of the source page.
A local surrogate benchmark must use a distinct surrogate authority/type and cannot overwrite these criteria.
Model agreement, reputation, governance decisions, or community votes cannot promote evidence into official criterion satisfaction.
Negative, null, contradictory, superseded, and failed evidence remain eligible for lineage retention.
